{{Quote|A survivor of one such attack, a security guard himself, claims the witness was not working alone.|The bounty posting on MI-726 describes the guard|<ref name="BTDF" />}}
A '''security guard''' worked at an [[Unidentified Imperial factory (MI-726)|Imperial factory]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. While the guard was working at the facility the rogue [[MI-series security droid]], [[MI-726]] [[Attack on an Imperial factory|attacked]] the [[Factory/Legends|factory]] and encountered the guard. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] insulted the guard's heritage and legitimacy before setting off an explosion that destroyed the entire factory. However, the individual survived and provided a statement on the attack to Imperial authorities in which he claimed the droid had not worked alone. The statement was then used as part of a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] posting placed on the [[Imperial Enforcement DataCore/Legends|Imperial Enforcement DataCore]] for MI-726.<ref name="BTDF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The guard was mentioned in the article "[[Bounties to Die For]]" in the [[Star Wars Gamer 6|sixth issue]] of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine series,<ref name="BTDF" /> which was released on [[September 4]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20010815.html|text=Hunting Down ''Gamer'' #6}}</ref> The magazines were supplements for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', and the guard was included as part of an entry on MI-726 written by [[S. Mitch Ritchie]].<ref name="BTDF" />
